body:
Final coordinator review of two published source-review shards found that several no-change outcomes defer already-authorized curation rather than identify a missing scientific fact. Worker04 head `0d2c73e5aee5adb88782537755472d9ca0c5c3cd`; worker08 head `7efd3f8b98f9e822431dcb510c2c242a2569cfc7`; both depend on #1158 at `e000d66`.

Concrete examples:

- Worker08 case `CM_NAME:b9a945a3356d0c885eea986a2f6223e78c8e7d7163ee95629061a640294cbbe8` (H2O deionized) correctly distinguishes deionization from distillation, but its remaining requirement is to perform native owner lookup and use or create the appropriately scoped owner. [DSMZ533](https://www.dsmz.de/microorganisms/medium/pdf/DSMZ_Medium533.pdf) explicitly identifies deionized water in both main and trace stock. No proposal or completed lookup disposition accompanies that deferred step.
- Worker08 case `CM_NAME:e69128522cfe555f63dd51d4a23ece86363290b3839180386b090f368b28d1cc` (glycine-NaOH buffer) preserves a source-defined concentration and pH, and correctly finds a receiving-medium volume transcription error. [JCM906](https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=906) specifies the separately prepared buffer. The decision defers representing the stock without explaining which missing fact prevents a bounded preparation identity. It must not be equated to pure glycine or assigned invented titrant amounts.
- Worker04 case `CM_NAME:2f91fab8feab468a33e48d01e2f0a1363b9ad70816766c69a1e8d68c0ed6f8d5` describes the [NBRC15](https://www.nite.go.jp/nbrc/catalogue/NBRCMediumDetailServlet?NO=15) treated, clarified V-8 preparation but defers representing it until later curation. Lack of a molecular mapping or extraction yield does not by itself establish that a source-qualified preparation cannot be represented with an honest partial assertion.

Related outcomes defer normality-qualified NaOH stocks, source-specific top layers, C9322 supplied-form review, and malted wheat meal because an exact molecular/ontology mapping or later complete-owner review is absent. These are leads for reassessment, not predetermined identity approvals. Genuine solvent, formulation, provenance or supplied-form uncertainties may remain after primary research.

Reassess the full no-change cohorts against MAPPING_SEMANTICS sections3/6 and add-media. Complete supported proposal work, or state the precise scientific fact still missing and the actual primary-source searches. Keep receiving-medium dose/unit repair separate from ingredient identity. Never invent concentrations, solvent, chemistry, product equivalence, component completeness, or exact ontology matches; preserve all native holds and old review bytes. Require separate skeptical review of successor evidence/payloads and ordinary commits/pushes on the existing worker branches. No maintained data or export approval is requested from workers.

This extends the same class of completeness problem seen in #1163 and #1193 to distinct final shards; those earlier findings remain preserved. Exact frozen decisions and capture hashes are retained in the coordinator's immutable `w04-w08-deferred-curation-v1/review-inputs.json` and will accompany the campaign evidence. This is a review-completeness finding, not a statement that every listed source must map.
title: Complete deferred source-qualified curation in worker04 and worker08 review shards
